items.item_text: 01. The information provided in your application must support your selected answers in the supplemental questions. The information you provide will be verified and documentation may be required. Please be as honest and accurate as possible. You may be asked to demonstrate your knowledge and skills in a work sample or during an interview. By completing this supplemental questionnaire you are attesting that the information you have provided is accurate. Any misstatements, omissions, or falsification of information may eliminate you from consideration or result in dismissal. Options: Yes, I understand and agree | No, I do not agree
02. I understand that the Santa Paula Unified School District Classified HR Office will communicate with me via email and that it is my responsibility to check my email. Options: Yes | No
03. Are you a current regular classified employee (substitute employment not included)? Options: Yes | No
04. Do you have a High School diploma or GED? Options: Yes | No
05. Do you have 48 units of completed college course work or an Associate's degree or higher? Options: Yes | No

06. I am attaching a copy of my college-level coursework showing completion of 48 semester units at an institution of higher education, or a copy of my Associate’s degree or higher. Select “Not Applicable” if you do not have qualifying college-level coursework or degree documentation. Note: If documentation is verified, you may not be required to take the written portion of the examination. Options: Yes | Not Applicable

07. Have you previously taken and passed Santa Paula Unified School District's Instructional Assistant written exam? Options: Yes | No | N/A, I have provided my transcripts with at least 48 college units.

08. Some positions require bilingual English/Spanish skills. Are you requesting consideration for one or more bilingual eligibility lists? Applicants seeking placement on a bilingual eligibility list will be required to participate in bilingual skills testing. Options: Yes, I am requesting consideration for bilingual eligibility lists. | No, I am only requesting consideration for non-bilingual eligibility lists.

09. Please select each classification for which you wish to be considered. Candidates will only be placed on eligibility lists for classifications selected below, provided they meet the minimum qualifications and successfully complete all required examination components. You will NOT be considered for positions you do not select. Options: Instructional Assistant — Assists a teacher with instruction, tutoring, lesson materials, classroom routines, student records, and monitoring students in a classroom or learning environment. | Instructional Assistant – Bilingual — Assists with instruction and tutoring for limited or non-English speaking students, including translating written materials, oral instruction, and parent/guardian communication as needed. | Instructional Assistant – After School Program — Supports school-aged children in an after-school program by helping with daily activities, supervision, homework support, attendance, transitions, and a safe program environment. | Instructional Assistant – After School Program Bilingual — Supports school-aged children in an after-school program and assists students in English or a designated second language with assignments, activities, and communication as needed. | Instructional Assistant – Special Education — Supports individual or small groups of students with disabilities in RSP or SDC programs, including instruction, behavior refocusing, progress reporting, records, and supervision. | Instructional Assistant – Special Education Bilingual — Supports students with disabilities in RSP or SDC programs and assists English or second-language speaking students with assignments and learning activities in a designated second language as needed. | Instructional Assistant – Extensive Support Needs — Supports students with extensive support needs, including IEP implementation, behavior support, health and safety monitoring, personal hygiene, toileting, feeding-related support if assigned, mobility/fine motor support, and close supervision. | Instructional Assistant – Extensive Support Needs Bilingual — Supports students with extensive support needs and assists in a designated second language, including IEP support, behavior support, health and safety monitoring, personal hygiene, toileting, fine motor support, and close supervision.

10. Special Education Assignment Acknowledgement: The Instructional Assistant–Special Education classifications support students with disabilities in RSP or SDC programs. Duties may include tutoring, reinforcing instruction, observing and refocusing behavior, reporting student progress, assisting with records, supervising students during school activities, and maintaining a positive learning environment. Are you willing to be considered for this type of assignment? Options: Yes | No | I did not select Instructional Assistant–Special Education or Instructional Assistant–Special Education Bilingual.

11. Extensive Support Needs Assignment Acknowledgment The Instructional Assistant–Extensive Support Needs classifications support students with significant learning and support needs. Duties may include assisting with IEP implementation, monitoring health conditions, responding to medical emergencies, redirecting behavior, supporting students whose behavior may escalate to self-injurious or physically aggressive acts, assisting with personal hygiene/toileting, and lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling heavy objects as assigned. Are you willing to be considered for this type of assignment? Options: Yes | No | I did not select Instructional Assistant–Extensive Support Needs or Instructional Assistant–Extensive Support Needs Bilingual.

12. Experience Working With Students Please describe any paid, volunteer, or personal experience you have supporting students or children in an educational, childcare, recreation, after-school, special education, or similar setting. If none, type “N/A.”

13. Temporary Assignment Interest: Are you interested in being considered for temporary Instructional Assistant assignments? Options: Yes, I am interested in temporary assignments. | No, I am only interested in regular positions

Assist a certificated teacher in providing instruction and/or tutoring to individuals or small groups of students in a classroom or other learning environment; assist with the implementation of lesson plans; reinforcing instruction as directed.
Perform a variety of duties in support of classroom activities such as preparing, typing, duplicating and filing instructional materials and maintaining student records and files as assigned.

Assist students with completing appropriate subject area classroom assignments, homework and projects; ensure student understanding of classroom rules and procedures; assist students by answering questions, providing proper examples, emotional support, friendly attitude and general guidance; confer with the teacher concerning lesson plans and materials to meet student needs.

Observe, monitor and redirect students in the classroom in accordance with approved classroom procedures; monitor students during outdoor activities as directed; assist with reporting progress regarding student performance and behavior.
Assist teacher(s) in administering various tests, preparing mandated reports and documentation as required.
Operate a variety of classroom and office equipment including a computer, copier, overhead projector and laminator as assigned.
Provide classroom support to the teacher by setting up work areas, displays and exhibits; distributing/collecting paper, supplies and materials.
Ensure the health and safety of students by following established practices and procedures; maintain learning environment in a safe, orderly and clean manner.
Participate in staff meetings; attend various in-service meetings as assigned.
